task: Owner decision 2026-11-05: unify the Keycloak login screen with the Portal (Portal tokens, Pretendard, card style, mascot, cookie dark/light sync) and brand the Keycloak admin console through officially supported admin theme properties and CSS only (no Keycloakify). Cover every page users reach, deliver through the existing ConfigMap mount (extended where it could not carry the admin theme), apply live and verify with a browser.

events.summary: Authoritative source found: the ConfigMap embedded in keycloak-cr.yaml, mounted with eight subPath mounts; gitops/resources/keycloak-theme/ was an unreferenced hand-synced mirror (no Application, script or test used it) and is deleted. Changed: login theme (skin over keycloak.v2), new admin theme, chart delivery (two ConfigMaps from the chart's keycloak-theme/ tree, one directory mount, checksum pod annotation), 11-2 adminTheme/loginTheme on narwhal and master, T2 assertion, R306, docs. Deliberately left alone: Keycloak version, realm users/clients, the Portal, Kakao cluster, quick-theme (not in 26.5 docs), Keycloakify.

Before: the old login theme replaced template.ftl with a PatternFly-free copy and listed only login/logout-confirm/info, so error, page-expired, update-password/profile, OTP and WebAuthn pages kept PatternFly class names with no PatternFly CSS; fonts were system fonts; the palette (Aurora Glacial) matched no Portal token; the admin console was stock Keycloak.

events.summary: Login: theme.properties parent=keycloak.v2, styles=css/styles.css css/narwhal.css, scripts=js/narwhal.js, darkMode=false; narwhal.css copies the Portal tokens (globals.css light and dark) and maps PatternFly global tokens; Pretendard Variable subset (303 KB woff2, SIL OFL) shipped in the theme; Portal mascot as brand mark; narwhal.js reads the narwhal-theme cookie before first paint and keeps the Enter/IME handling; info.ftl keeps the logout auto-redirect. Admin: theme.properties (parent keycloak.v2, logo, favIcon, title, styles) and narwhal-admin.css with PatternFly tokens only. Delivery: keycloak-theme.yaml renders two ConfigMaps from keycloak-theme/narwhal/ (text and binary), keycloak-cr.yaml mounts one directory and carries checksum/keycloak-theme so Keycloak rolls on any theme change. Deviations from Portal tokens, all for AA: links and focus use --narwhal-detail (5.4:1) in light instead of --narwhal-accent (3.7:1).

Defects closed by the new theme, each seen in the live pages: (1) pages the old theme did not override (error, update password/profile, OTP setup) rendered with unstyled PatternFly classes, now inherited from keycloak.v2 and skinned by tokens; (2) keycloak.v2 defines no alert icon classes, so alerts showed an empty icon slot, now kcFeedback*Icon are set in theme.properties; (3) an empty helper row left a gap above Sign in; (4) the login hardcoded 'Redirecting to portal login...' English text, now a KO/EN message; (5) the unreferenced mirror under gitops/resources/keycloak-theme that could drift from the deployed ConfigMap is removed.
